response.overview: Wild Angels tells the story of twin brothers, low-class criminals in Lima. Jhony, one of them, decides to start a new life away from crime and reconnect with his daughter. First, he must escape his boss, a corrupt police officer who, through pressure and threats, forces them back into prison to carry out dirty work. Along his difficult path to freedom, Jhony encounters an even greater and more dangerous obstacle: his brother Jhames, a cold-blooded killer with mental instability who is not only a dangerous criminal but also his lifelong friend and partner.
response.title: Ángeles Salvajes
